title: Composition of polynomial and randomized reductions
statement: Let $A$, $B$, and $C$ be languages of bit strings. If $A$ is polynomial-time reducible to $B$ and $B$ is randomized reducible to $C$, then $A$ is randomized reducible to $C$.
